_comment: Who says a word aloud when a speaker icon is pressed. lib/speak.js tries each voice in `order` and the first that can say the word plays it. Adding a voice is a block here plus one entry in lib/speak.js; reordering is an edit here only.
_repeat: A word pressed again within repeatMs is said at repeatSpeed, the way a teacher repeats a word slowly. Speeds are the names in `speeds` above; the Voice speed setting picks the usual one.
_pace: Speed of every made voice, server and phone; 1 = engine's own. The server reads this too.
_speeds: Pickable speeds, as a share of pace; the server accepts only these.

person._comment: One teacher saying each quiz word, recorded in the studio (record.html) and copied out by backend/scripts/export_recordings.py. First, because a person beats any made voice.

recorded._comment: A real reciter saying the word alone, from quran.com's word-by-word audio. Only Qur'an words; the map is built by backend/scripts/build_word_audio.py.

server._comment: Synthetic voice on this app's backend, for words not in the Qur'an.
server._version: Words are kept by the browser for a year. Change this whenever the server's voice changes, or a word already heard plays the old voice.

browser._comment: The device's own voice, the last resort. Varies by phone and may ignore harakat.
browser._preferred: Arabic voices to choose first, by name (part of it will do), best first: Apple's, Windows', Google's. Otherwise a voice on the device is used. Never a non-Arabic one: it spells the letters out.
browser._voicesTimeoutMs: Browsers often list no voices until a moment after load; how long to wait for them before saying there are none.
